name: mi-band-8-custom-apps
description: Custom Mi Band 8 utility and game apps with Suiteki installation workflow.

scripts.build:calculator: node scripts/patch-zeus-devices.js && cd apps/calculator && zeus build -t smart-band-7
scripts.build:dice-game: node scripts/patch-zeus-devices.js && cd apps/dice-game && zeus build -t smart-band-7
scripts.extract:all: node scripts/extract-device-bin.js calculator && node scripts/extract-device-bin.js dice-game
scripts.build:all: npm run build:calculator && npm run build:dice-game && npm run extract:all
